decisions.reason: A reusable citrus crate is a niche agricultural application, but it builds directly on the firm's injection-moulded crate know-how, so early market feedback can be readily interpreted and used to improve it.
The foldable large container is featured on its own page and extends the firm's core returnable-packaging competence, which gives strong absorptive capacity for refining it.
A stackable plastic crate sits at the heart of the firm's existing knowledge base, so it is low-risk and easy to improve through in-house development.
A medium-duty rackable pallet complements the firm's pallet portfolio and draws on related moulding and load-testing expertise, which justifies keeping it despite modest website visibility.
The spill-retention pallet has its own page and serves a regulated safety niche; it relies on adjacent knowledge the firm can assimilate, so management keeps it while learning from early results.
A pallet with load retainers is a close variant of core pallet technology, and its dedicated page signals commitment, so management keeps it.
